wire.tool_rows.bridge.roster.verb.failed.role: Collapsed Team Bridge roster tool row (TUI and phone transcript)
wire.tool_rows.bridge.roster.verb.failed.note: A complete phrase for a failed or refused read-only attempt to list members of an existing group or channel. Do not name or imply access to a specific room. No noun or count follows it; keep it short. No ICU arguments.

wire.tool_rows.bridge.roster.verb.runnin.role: Collapsed Team Bridge roster tool row (TUI and phone transcript)
wire.tool_rows.bridge.roster.verb.runnin.note: A complete phrase while a read-only request for the member list of an existing group or channel is pending. No noun or count follows it; keep it short. No ICU arguments.

wire.tool_rows.bridge.roster.verb.settle.role: Collapsed Team Bridge roster tool row (TUI and phone transcript)
wire.tool_rows.bridge.roster.verb.settle.note: A complete phrase after a successful read of members of an existing group or channel. The room is unnamed. A separately localized count, for example (3 members), may follow. Keep it short. No ICU arguments.
